title: 第009章 拆家狂魔
content_zh:
刘恒离开了。
可是刘长的心却迟迟不能平静。
来到这个世界也有一段时间了，在这些时日里，刘长一直都在抱怨，他觉得自己压根不喜欢这个落后的时代，他也觉得自己不属于这里，他不明白自己来到这里的意义，他早已放弃了思索，准备安心当一个诸侯王，混过这一生。
可是刘恒的话，却忽然让他惊醒，如果自己临时起意准备做出来的一个小东西，都有着造福全天下的伟力，那自己为什么不多做一些呢？
与其每天在天禄阁荒废时日，倒不如做些有意义的事情。
这大概是小刘长第一次变得这么认真，整整一天，他都是站在母亲的纺车面前，认真的观察着这台纺车。
虽然原理上相差不多，可这东西跟后世的纺机还是有很大不同的，刘长拆纺机那是在很多很多年之前，在真正动手之前，他得打好草稿。
刘长这里是有不少纸张的，不过，这些纸张十分的珍贵，别说是皇子，就是刘邦，也很少会使用纸张，更多的还是运用竹简。刘长这些纸是凭自己的努力获取的，这都是他从原先教他的那位大儒身边偷来的。
就在刘长观察着纺车，思索着自己该如何动手制作的时候，吕后已经回来了。
吕后不知去了哪里，总之，她不是很开心，看起来正在气头上，可陷入沉思之中的刘长并没有注意到她，吕后径直的走进了内殿，换了衣裳，走出来的时候，看到刘长还蹲在纺车面前玩，也就没有在意。
直到宫女禀告了刘恒来找刘长的事情，方才引起了吕后的好奇。
“长，过来。”
刘长惊醒，这才笑呵呵的扑到了吕后的身边。
“阿母~~”
“恒来过？”
“是啊，四哥早上来过一次。”
“他来干什么？”
“没什么，就给我带了礼物，嘿嘿..”
刘长咧嘴笑着，显然对这礼物十分的满意。
吕后却皱起了眉头，她伸出手来，一把将刘长拽到了自己的怀里，严肃的说道：“将求于人，则先下之。”

“什么意思？”
“有求于人，就要先居于人下。”
“不会有人无缘无故的对你表达善意，送你礼物，若是有人这么做，那你就要小心，因为他们很可能是有别的想法，有不好的企图。”
刘长一愣，有些惊讶的说道：“可我觉得四哥不像是对我有不好的企图啊..”
“我不是说你四哥不好，不过，我的话，你要记在心里，明白吗？”
刘长点了点头，若有所思。
“去玩吧，纺车给你了，别弄伤自己。”
刘长大喜，就要往阿母脸上啄一口，忽然，他意识到了什么，表情变得凝重，喃喃道：“将求于人，则先下之？”
吕后那荣辱不惊的脸上第一次出现了惊愕。
她往刘长的后脑勺上拍了一下，骂道：“不是这么用的！”
得到了吕后的口谕，刘长就可以正式动手拆纺车了，吕后若是知道她的这个恩赐会将那台纺车送给刘长....
刘长用了两天的时间，画出了一个略微专业的纺机的设计图。
“综架横梁，综框传动绳索，综框，丝筘上轨，丝筘，梭子，综丝，丝筘下轨，丝筘固定螺栓，纬线，卷布轴，棘轮撑，捏轴，机架....踏板，摇臂，经线，分经杆，提综滑轮....”
没错，刘长已经放弃了原先的想法，他原来只是想要改进一下纺车，可在听到刘恒的那些话后，他决定打造一台最先进的纺织机！在木制材料领域里，他设计的这个纺织机，绝对算得上是最先进的。
这些构建都是木制的，这样一来，材料就不会是问题，大汉有的是木头。
可当刘长准备动手的时候，他才发现，光有锯子不行，他还得有尺，不然没法测量长度，另外，若是能弄到刨刀，锉刀，斧子那就更好了。可刘长又不好意思继续跟刘恒开口索要。
刘恒可以轻易去隔壁找匠人，可他却出不去，这得功与他前身那恶劣的性格，大概是怕他出去殴打他人吧...
刘长决定等到天禄阁开学的时候，再找个机会让刘恒带自己去一趟隔壁，去借个尺子，刨，锉什么的，连锯都能借到，再借几个工具大概也不难，在这之前，自己还是多去准备些材料，到时候就可以直接拿来用。
纺车很快就被刘长拆掉了，纺车内的梭子，摇臂，滑轮，踏板等等，是可以直接拿来用的，都不需要做太多更改，刘长决定就在这些东西的基础上进行再制作。
可他要做的纺织机，起码要比面前这个纺车大两圈，光是这些材料还不行。

于是乎，他就带着锯整日在皇宫内溜达，四处寻找可以用的材料...每当他拿起锯在椒房殿内比划的时候，那些宫女们都是被吓得半死，生怕他把殿内的主梁给锯下来。
当然，给刘长十个胆子，他也不敢拆了老娘的椒房殿，别看刘邦凶巴巴的，实际上，刘邦下手还是比较轻的，刘长记得自己当初在宫外丢石头玩，在大舅舅脑袋上砸出个大包后的下场。
大舅舅倒是没有在意这一点，只是笑吟吟的抱着他，说当年上战场都没有负伤，没想到栽在一个小娃娃手里。
但是，大舅舅不追责，阿母可气坏了，揍得刘长三天没能下榻，屁股肿了。
大舅舅是一个好人，他还在世的时候，每次进宫都会陪刘长玩，可二舅舅总绷着脸，跟阿母一个样，不苟言笑。
未央宫才建造，因此宫内还没有达到郁郁葱葱的地步，木材也不是那么好获取的，此刻的大汉宫殿，看起来反而有些凄凉，处处都是灰白色的，还没来得及上色，时不时有宦官低着头路过，急匆匆的。
刘长在皇宫内考察了许久，终于找到了一个珍贵的原材料获取地。
首先，这里不是什么大殿的房梁，不会有什么危险，而且根本就没有人来这里，就是一个空摆设，没有什么实用性，倒不如让自己拿来为天下苍生谋福利。
刘长将获取的木头藏在了附近，每天他灰头土脸的回到椒房殿，倒头就睡。
吕后看着熟睡的他，看着一旁的宫女，“他还在造那个纺车？”
“是的...公子也是一片孝心...”
吕后没有再说什么，实际上，早在刘长有这个想法之后的第二天，吕后就已经知道了这个家伙准备给自己的惊喜，后宫之主可不是跟你闹着玩的，皇宫内但凡有些风吹草动，吕后通常都是最先知道的。
吕后是华夏第一个皇后，毕竟华夏第一个皇帝没有册立皇后，这个时代尚且不知该如何对待皇后，也不知道该如何确定皇后所拥有的权力，后宫不得干政也没有出现。因此，皇后的权力大的吓人。
不仅可以干涉政务，甚至还可以对皇帝的任命指手画脚。
.......
“这是朕打造的一处新亭阁，这里通常没有人前来，三面都是假山，朕坐在这里，能享片刻的清闲...”
刘邦大步走在碎石小道上，走的有些累了，就干脆脱掉了鞋履，光脚徒步，而跟在他的身边的，则是一个面相冷峻的中年人。两人一前一后的走在这小道上，在不远处，则是有一群甲士，冷冷的盯着这里。
这中年人的眉毛是往上翘的，这让他看起来很强势，甚至是有些吓人，而他身形消瘦，骨架却不小，他穿着相当的朴素，稳步跟随在刘邦的身后。
“怎么不说话？在这里，我们不是君臣，只是好友而已，别像朝中那么的拘束啊。”
刘邦扣了扣脚底板，咧嘴笑着说道。

“既然是朋友间的聚会，那为什么身后跟着那么多的精锐甲士呢？”
“这你可错怪朕了，朕是在跟猛虎同行，那些甲士怎么敢放松呢？”
中年人忽然笑了起来，笑了片刻，又突兀的停了下来。
“你觉得樊哙这个人怎么样呢？”
“忠勇，威壮，是一个不错的先锋，可不够格做大将。”
“那你觉得曹参这个人怎么样呢？”
“听话，能很好的执行命令，但是没有自己的主见，能破敌但不能领军。”
content_en:
Liu Heng left.
But Liu Chang's heart could not calm down for a long time.
It has been a while since he came to this world. During these days, Liu Chang has been complaining. He feels that he does not like this backward era at all. He also feels that he does not belong here. He does not understand the meaning of his coming here. He has already given up thinking and is ready to live his life as a vassal king.
But Liu Heng's words suddenly awakened him. If a small thing he prepared to make on the spur of the moment had the power to benefit the whole world, then why didn't he make more?
Instead of wasting time in Tianlu Pavilion every day, it is better to do something meaningful.
This was probably the first time that little Liu Chang became so serious. For the whole day, he stood in front of his mother's spinning wheel and carefully observed the spinning wheel.
Although the principle is similar, this thing is still very different from the spinning machines of later generations. It was many, many years ago that Liu Chang dismantled the spinning machine. Before he actually started working on it, he had to make a good draft.
Liu Chang has a lot of paper here, but these papers are very precious. Not to mention the prince, even Liu Bang rarely uses paper, and more often uses bamboo slips. Liu Chang obtained these papers through his own efforts. He stole them from the great scholar who originally taught him.
Just as Liu Chang was observing the spinning wheel and thinking about how to make it, Queen Lu had already returned.
I don’t know where Empress Lu went. In short, she was not very happy and seemed to be angry. However, Liu Chang, who was deep in thought, did not notice her. Empress Lu went straight into the inner hall and changed her clothes. When she came out, she saw Liu Chang still squatting in front of the spinning wheel and playing, so she didn’t pay attention.
It wasn't until the palace maid reported Liu Heng's visit to Liu Chang that Empress Lu became curious.
"Chief, come here."
Liu Chang woke up with a start and rushed to Empress Lu's side with a smile.
"Mom~~"
"Heng has been here?"
"Yes, fourth brother came here once in the morning."
"What is he here for?"
"Nothing, just brought me a gift, hehe..."
Liu Chang grinned, obviously very satisfied with the gift.
Empress Lu frowned. She stretched out her hand, pulled Liu Chang into her arms, and said seriously: "If you want to ask someone for something, do it first."
"What do you mean?"
"If you want to ask for help from others, you must first be subordinate to them."
"No one will express kindness to you or give you gifts for no reason. If someone does this, then you have to be careful, because they may have other ideas and bad intentions."
Liu Chang was stunned and said with some surprise: "But I don't think Fourth Brother has any bad intentions towards me..."
"I'm not saying that your fourth brother is bad, but you have to keep my words in mind, do you understand?"
Liu Chang nodded, thoughtfully.
"Go and play, I'll give you the spinning wheel, don't hurt yourself."
Liu Chang was so happy that he was about to peck his mother on the face. Suddenly, he realized something, his expression became solemn, and he murmured: "When you ask for something from others, do you do it first?"
For the first time, shock appeared on Queen Lu's face, which was calm about honor and disgrace.
She slapped Liu Chang on the back of the head and cursed: "That's not how it's used!"
After receiving the oral instructions from Empress Lu, Liu Chang could officially start to dismantle the spinning wheel. If Empress Lu knew about her gift, she would give the spinning wheel to Liu Chang...
Liu Chang spent two days drawing a slightly professional design of the textile machine.
"Heald frame beam, heald frame transmission rope, heald frame, reed upper rail, reed, shuttle, heald, reed lower rail, reed fixing bolts, weft thread, winding shaft, ratchet support, pinch shaft, frame...Pedal, rocker arm, warp thread, warp dividing rod, heald lifting pulley..."
That's right, Liu Chang had given up his original idea. He originally just wanted to improve the spinning wheel, but after hearing Liu Heng's wordsAfter talking about it, he decided to build a state-of-the-art textile machine! In the field of wooden materials, the textile machine he designed is definitely the most advanced.
These structures are all made of wood, so materials won't be an issue, and the big man has plenty of wood.
But when Liu Chang was about to take action, he discovered that a saw alone was not enough. He also needed a ruler, otherwise he would not be able to measure the length. In addition, it would be better if he could get a planer, file, and axe. But Liu Chang was embarrassed to continue asking Liu Heng.
Liu Heng could easily go next door to find the craftsman, but he couldn't get out. This was due to his bad character in his predecessor, probably because he was afraid that he would go out and beat others...
Liu Chang decided to wait until Tianlu Pavilion started school, and then find an opportunity to ask Liu Heng to take him to the next door to borrow a ruler, planer, file, etc. You can even borrow a saw. It is probably not difficult to borrow a few more tools. Before that, he had better prepare more materials so that he can use them directly.
The spinning wheel was quickly dismantled by Liu Chang. The shuttle, rocker arm, pulley, pedals, etc. in the spinning wheel can be used directly without making too many changes. Liu Chang decided to make them based on these things.
But the textile machine he wants to make is at least two circles larger than the spinning wheel in front of him, and these materials alone are not enough.
So, he took the saw and walked around the palace all day long, looking for usable materials... Whenever he picked up the saw to draw in the Jiaofang Hall, the palace ladies were scared to death, fearing that he would saw off the main beams in the hall.
Of course, given Liu Chang's courage, he would not dare to demolish my mother's Jiaofang Palace. Despite Liu Bang's fierceness, in fact, Liu Bang's attack was relatively light. Liu Chang remembered what happened to him when he was throwing rocks outside the palace and smashed a big bag on his uncle's head.
The eldest uncle didn't care about this, he just hugged him with a smile and said that he was not injured in the battlefield, but he didn't expect to fall into the hands of a little baby.
However, when the eldest uncle did not hold him accountable, my mother was so angry that she beat Liu Chang until he could not stay in bed for three days and his buttocks became swollen.
The eldest uncle was a good man. When he was still alive, he would play with Liu Chang every time he went to the palace, but the second uncle always had a sullen face, just like my mother, and was unsmiling.
Weiyang Palace had just been built, so the palace was not yet lush and green, and wood was not so easy to obtain. At this moment, the Han Palace looked a bit desolate, with gray and white everywhere, and there was no time to paint it. From time to time, eunuchs passed by in a hurry with their heads lowered.
Liu Chang inspected the palace for a long time and finally found a place to obtain precious raw materials.
First of all, this is not a beam in the main hall, there will be no danger, and no one comes here at all. It is just an empty decoration with no practicality. It is better to use it for the benefit of the people in the world.
Liu Chang hid the wood nearby. Every day he returned to Jiaofang Hall in disgrace and fell asleep.
Queen Lu looked at him sleeping soundly and at the palace maid beside her, "He is still building that spinning wheel?"
"Yes...Young Master is also very filial..."
Queen Lu didn't say anything else. In fact, as early as the day after Liu Chang had this idea, Queen Lu already knew the surprise this guy was planning to give her. The master of the harem is not playing around with you. Whenever there is any trouble in the palace, Queen Lu is usually the first to know.
Empress Lu was the first queen in China. After all, the first emperor in China did not appoint a queen. In this era, we still didn’t know how to treat the queen, nor how to determine the power the queen had. The harem was not allowed to interfere in politics and did not appear. Therefore, the queen's power is terrifying.
Not only can they interfere in government affairs, but they can even give instructions on the emperor's appointment.
.......
"This is a new pavilion built by me. This place usuallyNo one comes here, there are rockeries on three sides, I can sit here and enjoy a moment of leisure..."
Liu Bang strode along the gravel path. He was a little tired, so he simply took off his shoes and walked barefoot. Following him was a middle-aged man with a stern face. The two of them walked on the path one after another. Not far away, there was a group of soldiers, staring coldly at this place.
This middle-aged man's eyebrows were raised, which made him look very strong, even a little scary. He was thin but had a large frame. He was dressed quite plainly and followed Liu Bang steadily.
"Why don't you speak? Here, we are not monarchs and ministers, we are just friends. Don’t be so restrained as in the court. "
Liu Bang clicked the soles of his feet and said with a grin.
“Since it’s a gathering among friends, why are there so many elite soldiers following behind us? "
"You are wrong to blame me for this. I am walking with the tiger. How dare those soldiers relax? "
The middle-aged man suddenly laughed, laughed for a moment, and then stopped abruptly.
"What do you think of Fan Kuai? "
"He is loyal, brave and mighty. He is a good pioneer, but he is not qualified to be a general. "
"Then what do you think of Cao Shen? "
"Be obedient and can carry out orders well, but have no ideas of his own. He can defeat the enemy but cannot lead the army. "
